fields for stage 'Intake' (Node-graph invariants: Field needs Model + CreatedAt). Every Select carries `referred_list: None` plus a `referred_list_from` BINDING, never an id — a plan is compiled before anything is created. THE EXECUTOR MUST RESOLVE IT before calling forge_apply_fields: take the `_id` returned by the preceding create_list op for that `list_name` (OP_ORDER runs create_list first), or, when `from_op` is None (a personal_data list, human-made per PDPA), the id of the human-made list of that name read off the tenant. Left unresolved the write REFUSES the field loudly, which is the intended failure: a Select written with no ReferredList PUTs 200 and its publish dies 500 MetadataError with zero diagnostics
